name: Memuro (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Memuro town emblem in green: a stylised blossom of four wedge-shaped petals.
history: Municipal flag of Memuro, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1999.

features.role: Memuro town emblem — a stylised blossom of four wedge-shaped petals
